mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('20', #{year}) AS year, COUNT(*) AS totCnt FROM statistic.request_info WHERE create_date LIKE CONCAT('20', #{year}, '%')
SELECT CONCAT('20', #{yearMonth}) AS yearMonth, COUNT(*) AS totCnt FROM statistic.request_info WHERE create_date LIKE CONCAT('20', SUBSTR(#{yearMonth}, 1, 2), '-', SUBSTR(#{yearMonth}, 3, 2), '%')
SELECT SUBSTR(create_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS userCount FROM request_info GROUP BY SUBSTR(create_date, 1, 7)
SELECT create_date AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS userCount FROM request_info GROUP BY create_date
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT create_date), 1) AS averageCount FROM request_info
SELECT create_date FROM request_info WHERE DAYOFWEEK(create_date) NOT IN (1, 7)

SELECT u.hr_organ AS department, SUBSTR(r.create_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(r.request_id) AS loginCount FROM request_info r INNER JOIN `user` u ON r.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.hr_organ, SUBSTR(r.create_date, 1, 7)
